definitions.full: H6936. qodqod קָדְקֹד noun [masculine] head, crown of head ; — ׳ק absolute Deut 33:20 ; Jer 2:16 , construct Isa 3:17 +; suffix קָדְקֳדוֺ 2Sam 14:25 ; Job 2:7 ; קָדְקֳדֶ֑ךָ Deut 28:25 ; — especially poet, Gen 49:26 = Deut 33:16 ; Psa 7:17 , ׳ק שֵׂעָר 68:22 hairy crown or scalp (all || ראֹשׁ ), Isa 3:17 ; Jer 2:16 ; 48:45 (|| מֵּאָה ), so read also Num 24:17 for וְקַרְקַר (|| id. ), see Ew Di Pat and others, Deut 33:20 ; in prose only וְעַדקֿ רֶגֶל ׳מִכַּף 28:35 ; 2Sam 14:25 ; Job 2:7 . קַרְקַר Num 24:17 read קָדְקֹד q. v.
